episodes.title: All That Is in the Heavens and All That Is in the Earth
episodes.summary: Sitara, a young slave girl, is sold to a family of scholars, where she begins her journey of knowledge.

episodes.title: The Roses That Bloom in Safar
episodes.summary: As nomads sack the city of Tun, Fatima and Sitara hide in the basement and wait for the others to return.

episodes.title: Otchigin
episodes.summary: Sitara begins tutoring Sorghaghtani in Euclid's Elements, and learns more about Prince Tolui, the Otchigin.

episodes.title: A Snake Shows Its Colors, Man Hides His Colors
episodes.summary: Sitara agrees to serve as Sorghaghtani's spy, but her plans to infiltrate Chagatai's court quickly go awry.

episodes.title: The Mergen People
episodes.summary: Töregene tells the tale of her life among the Merkits, a confederation of tribes renowned for their archery.

episodes.title: Brothers
episodes.summary: As the Mongol Empire prepares to wage war to the east, Sitara begins to plant the seeds of political intrigue.

episodes.title: Great Khatun Boraqchin
episodes.summary: After a misunderstanding, Sitara finds herself before the sickly Boraqchin, chief empress of the Mongols.

episodes.title: Wisdom
episodes.summary: Tolui meets a shocking fate, and Sitara receives an unexpected item that shakes her to the core of her being.
